blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trisha Tubu showed why she is the reigning Season Most Valuable Player, spearheading Farm Fresh Foxies’ charge to a second straight semifinals appearance in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. At the center of Farm Fresh’s continued rise is the five-time Best Opposite Spiker, who answered the call with explosive performances against Capital1 and PLDT to earn the PVL Press Corps Player of the Week honors for the period of November 10-14. The ever-reliable product of Adamson unloaded a 25-point bomb over the Solar Spikers in their 25-17, 25-21, 23-25, 25-23 triumph on Saturday, which sealed the Foxies […]...
